note: Flattened from the Anima All-In-One UI workflow. Loom injects the prompt at positive_node.text and collects images from output_node. inject_models rebuilds the LoRA chain at lora_anchor.
description: Anima all-in-one image pipeline. A single base render flows left→right through optional refinement stages, each gated by a switch so it can be skipped: face detailer, an UltimateSDUpscale pass, and two hi-res latent passes. Loom drives the gates per generation type — pick a Compose mode below to see which stages run for sprites, scenes, or standard images.

s1736.name: Input / VAE
s1736.desc: Loads the VAE and the img2img path: when a source image is supplied it is encoded to latent here; a switch selects txt2img (empty latent) vs img2img.

s890.name: Model Setup
s890.desc: Assembles the diffusion model: UNet + CLIP loaders, the LoRA stack apply, AuraFlow model-sampling, optional Anima Mod Guidance, KSampler config, and the base positive/negative prompt encode. inject_models rebuilds the LoRA chain here.

s893.name: SAM3 Load
s893.desc: Segmentation model load slot (vestigial in the flattened graph — no active nodes; the detailer uses its own SAM/Impact loaders).

s900.name: Resolution
s900.desc: Canvas sizing: width/height primitives plus square/landscape toggles drive the EmptyLatentImage. Loom overrides this per render (portrait sprite vs landscape scene).

__styles__.name: Style Presets
__styles__.desc: A bank of selectable LoRA style stacks (Lora Stacker nodes) routed through an ImpactSwitch — choose one preset to bias the look without touching the model setup.

s1284.name: Primary Sampler
s1284.desc: The core render: the main KSampler with Anima LLLite + Mod Guidance, then VAEDecode to the base image. A new-seed switch controls whether each run re-rolls the seed. Everything after this is optional refinement.

s1508.name: Routing
s1508.desc: A single switch that routes the primary render either straight to output or into the detailer/upscale chain. The 'Use Detailer' gate at the top of the post-processing fork.

s1530.name: Face Detailer
s1530.desc: FaceDetailer pass: detects faces and re-renders them at higher fidelity (with optional DCW + Spectrum patches). Gated by 'Use Detailer' — on for character gens, off for scenes. → detailer flag.

s1541.name: Upscale
s1541.desc: UltimateSDUpscale: tiled upscale with an upscale model for final-resolution detail. Slow; gated by 'Using USDU'. → upscale flag.

s1633.name: Hi-Res Pass A
s1633.desc: First hi-res fix: latent/image upscale feeding a second KSampler for added detail. Gated by 'Use HighRez'. → highrez flag.

s1634.name: Hi-Res Pass B
s1634.desc: Second hi-res refinement KSampler pass, chained after Pass A for extra sharpening. Part of the highrez chain.

__top__.name: Output & Config
__top__.desc: Final plumbing: Image Saver, seed source, sampler/scheduler selectors, prompt string assembly, the LoadImage img2img source, and the preview bridge.

standard.label: Standard image
standard.desc: Single base render at full quality, background intact. No detailer or upscale — the fast path. Use for general illustrations and establishing shots.

sprite.label: Clipped sprite
sprite.desc: Character portrait with the face detailer on and the background removed, producing a transparent cutout for layering in chat. Portrait framing, no upscale.

scene.label: Scene
scene.desc: Full-background environment in landscape, with the UltimateSDUpscale pass on for crisp detail across the frame. Face detailer off — scenes rarely need it.
